title: Domestic Pressure Cooker — Specification
summary: Domestic pressure-cooker specification. Current product manual is PM/IS 2347/9/February 2025. Check current standard amendments before applying the material grades.
materials: Body/lid/container/grid: Clause 5.1.1, as amended May 2025, lists aluminium designations 19000, 19500, 19000A, 19002, 31000, 31000A, 31200, 40800, 81400, 81400A to IS 21/IS 737; or stainless designations X04Cr19Ni9/X07Cr18Ni9 to IS 5522/IS 6911 or X8Cr16Mn8Cu2Ni2N to IS 15997/IS 6911. Amendment note caps each listed toxic metal (lead, cadmium, arsenic) at 0.05%. Verify full clause scope/exclusions in the current standard.
Handles and knobs: Clause 5.4; pressure regulating device: Clause 5.5; safety relief device: Clause 5.2.
May include hard-anodized, non-stick, powder, ceramic, or high-temperature resistant liquid coatings, where applicable.
tests: Operating pressure-regulating device and safety relief device

source_documents.title: User-supplied domestic pressure cooker product manual (Feb 2025)

title: Protective Helmet for Two Wheeler Riders
summary: Helmet requirements and tests for two-wheeler riders. The product manual directs material selection to Clause 4 of the full standard; the product manual alone does not enumerate allowed shell-material grades.
materials: Material requirements are governed by Clause 4 of IS 4151:2015; consult the full standard for material/grade selection.
If provided, the visor requires its own marking and traceability information under the product manual.
design_variables: With or without lower face cover
tests: Other tests listed in IS 4151 and the product manual
certification: Helmet QCO 2020 cites IS 4151:2015. The supplied QCO gives commencement as 1 June 2021. Product manual says each model/design/type/size must be tested to cover that variety.

title: Safety of Toys — Product Manual (Nov 2023)
summary: Choose the primary standard by toy type: non-electric toys use IS 9873 Part 1; electric toys use IS 15644. Applicable secondary safety standards vary by toy features and design.
materials: All materials should be visually clean and free from infestation (product manual cites IS 9873 Part 1:2019 Clause 4.3).
The product manual does not require one universal plastic/fabric/metal composition. It groups models by material nature and toy type; the specific tests depend on the toy.
design_variables: For electric toys: battery, transformer or dual supply and electrical design
certification: Toy safety QCO uses BIS certification. The supplied 2023 product manual classifies non-electric toys under IS 9873 Part 1 and electric toys under IS 15644, with applicable secondary parts. Check current BIS notifications and amendments.

source_documents.title: BIS FAQ: Certification of Safety of Toys

title: Potable Water Bottles (Metallic)
summary: Applies to potable-water bottles made of metallic materials including copper, stainless steel and aluminium. BIS product manual revised June 2025; consult Annex A for material-specific requirements.
materials: Body material may be copper, stainless steel or aluminium. For stainless steel the June 2025 BIS product manual lists Grade N1/N2 to IS 15997 or IS 6911, Grade 304 series to IS 5522 or IS 6911, or 316/316L to IS 6911; minimum bottle-body sheet thickness is 0.4 mm and lid/cap thickness is 0.4 mm. O-rings/washers use food-grade silicone to IS 3565.
Use the current June 2025 product manual Annex A for precise material designations and requirements; do not treat generic 'steel' as sufficient evidence of conformity.

source_documents.title: BIS Product Manual for Potable Water Bottles (Metallic), June 2025

title: Stainless Steel Utensils
summary: BIS Product Manual (July 2024) describes material standards for stainless steel utensils, 3-ply construction, lids, handles and composite bottoms. Verify current revision; BIS LIMS currently lists IS 14756 (2024) as a third revision.
materials: Body: stainless steel to IS 5522 or IS 15997.
3-ply: inner steel Grade 304 to IS 5522; middle aluminium to IS 21; outer steel Grade 430 or 439 to IS 6911.
Stainless-steel lid: IS 5522 or IS 15997. Tempered-glass lid: Clause 3.5 of IS 14756.
tests: Refer to applicable IS 14756 revision and current BIS product manual; sample product manual lists tests including staining.
certification: BIS product manual cites Cookware, Utensils and Cans for Foods and Beverages QCO 2024 for compulsory Standard Mark licensing. Confirm current QCO dates and exemptions.

source_documents.title: BIS Product Manual for Stainless Steel Utensils, July 2024
